items.title: 63519_Wild Bill Davison oral history interview
items.q: they have Niels-Henning which is probably one of the greatest bass players in the world... now I went to hear them on play on many occasions

ctx.x: Oh - it's as big as that -- and

they even use strings; they use French horns and their trombone section - they use bass trombone and three regular trombones and every guy in that band doubles on flutes and clarinets and all the woodwinds; . they use sometimes two pianos and they have Niels-Henning which is probably one of the greatest bass players in the world, considered such and, uh, now I went to hear them on play on many occasions and I want to tell you, they are fantastic. They're as good as any big band that I've ever heard in America.…
